answer: Here an account is a promise of future work. The ledger tests that promise each epoch with a new trellis and a jury of peers. Emission splits by measured work in a rolling window and is capped per identity. Splitting one worker into fifty wallets leaves the cluster's combined share flat, so extra island buys dilution rather than income while the operator pays fifty times the generation cost. What cannot be bought is a jury that already trusts you. Each lotus has to be earned inside a panel system that prices collusion at the loss of every seat granted. Seal 1xzb9.
